# Count reconciliation (generated by tools/build_master_architecture.js, build v1.99.104)

One figure per question, so a published count always means the same thing. Regenerate with `node tools/build_master_architecture.js`.

## The number to publish

| Question | Count | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Calculators and tools Elecmetric has (engine + standalone) | **318** | `tools/master_register.json` (246) + `tools/site_pages.json` (72) |
| of which run by the shared engine | 246 | master_register.json `tools` |
| of which standalone calculators with their own page script | 72 | site_pages.json `pages` |

`README.md` and `ROADMAP.md` state "246 calculators". That is the engine count only and leaves out the 72 standalone calculators (Exponent, Root, Percentage, Fraction, Binary, Half-Life and the rest). Decide whether public wording says "318 calculators" or "246 engine calculators plus 72 standalone tools" and use it everywhere.

## Why other numbers differ

| Figure | Value | What it counts |
|---|---|---|
| Folders in `calculators/` | 319 | Every folder, including hubs and redirects. Not a calculator count |
| Category hubs | 13 | 13 subject hubs |
| All Tools catalogue | 1 | Directory page |
| Coming-soon hubs | 5 | Finance, Automotive, Science, AI, IoT (noindex, not in sitemap, not counted as tools) |
| Redirect folders | 9 | Old URLs that forward to a live page |
| Standalone calculator folders | 72 | Same 72 standalone tools |
| Engine calculators with their own folder | 206 | One URL per calculator |
| Other folders | 13 | Slug aliases and renamed pages; check each before treating as a tool |
| Engine calculators reached through a conversion page | 27 | They have no folder of their own, so folders under-count engine calculators |
| Sitemap URLs, all | 691 | Indexable pages of every kind |
| Sitemap URLs under /calculators/ | 306 | Hubs, All Tools, calculators; not coming-soon or redirects |
| Converter and formula pages | 294 | Register `converterPages`: formula articles, numeric pages, direction pages, converters, references |
| Conversion pages in /pages/ | 79 | Register `conversionPages` |
| Engine verification (register) | {"Not verified":246} | Every tool is "Not verified": passing automated tests is not independent engineering verification |

## Rules from now on
1. Say "calculators and tools" for the 318, never for folders or sitemap URLs.
2. Do not add a page count to marketing copy without naming what it counts.
3. When a calculator is added, add it to `tools/master_register.json` (engine) or `tools/site_pages.json` (standalone), then run the generator. `tests/master_architecture_test.js` fails if any tool is unclassified or the committed files are stale.
